# DeliciousDuck

DeliciousDuck.com is a cooking authority site focused on buying, preparing, and cooking duck. It publishes detailed recipes, technique guides, ingredient explainers, gear reviews, and interactive calculators for home cooks and curious eaters.

## What you can do here

- Browse recipes for duck breast, duck legs, whole duck, and duck confit.
- Read technique guides on scoring, rendering fat, doneness, resting, and carving.
- Use interactive calculators: serving sizes, cooking time, doneness, fat substitutions, recipe scaling, and pairings.
- Compare places to buy duck online and find the right pans, thermometers, and knives.

## Content policies

- Recipes marked `editorialDraft` follow established technique and published safety guidance but have not been kitchen-tested in the DeliciousDuck kitchen; they should never be described as tested.
- Food safety guidance is conservative and sourced from USDA recommendations.
- Affiliate links are disclosed on every monetized page and in the affiliate disclosure.
